name: Mandel AI
long_description:
Mandel runs the operational work across direct-materials sourcing and ordering - from RFQ through invoice - for manufacturers and distributors. It coordinates suppliers, checks orders and invoices against agreed terms, resolves discrepancies, recovers supplier credits, and keeps the ERP current.

Working across email, supplier portals, EDI, and ERP systems, Mandel investigates issues and carries out the next steps within your team’s approval rules.
one_liner: AI Coordination Layer for Supply Chain
